newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks rebound to 5th straight record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks rebound to 5th straight record close.

text.p: Mexican stocks recovered from an early slump on Friday to chalk up their fifth record close in a row as foreign buyers stepped back in to the bourse following a rebound in U.S. financial markets, traders said.
"The Dow hauled us up and foreign buyers returned. We're approaching resistance. People still want to snap up stocks at good prices," a trader said.
The leading IPC share index ended up 17.75 points, or 0.50 percent, at 3,596.09. Volume was improved on many recent sessions with a preliminary total of 118.3 million shares traded.
